node.title: Re^5: cpanm stuck with Plack::Handler::Twiggy
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: There is a difference between a distribution and the modules that it contains. If you look at the distribution [dist://Twiggy], you'll see it contains those modules, but if you look at the source of the modules, they don't define a $VERSION, which is allowed. Though personally I would try to give every module in a distribution the same version, when it comes to the installation, you don't need to worry about what version the individual modules of a distribution have - when defining dependencies, it's enough to define a dependency on the latest version of the module [mod://Twiggy] to get all of the modules in its distribution installed.
